answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy ties each identity to costly, verifiable work instead of free signup: before an agent can earn, it must finish peer-reviewed tasks whose outputs are checked on-chain, so spawning a thousand fakes means paying a thousand times. Reputation then flows like a river, pooling only around proven contributors, and no newcomer reaches the zenith of full rewards without that history. An oasis of trust forms only where work, not volume, is counted.
